comments.body:
I'm not sure where the issue is, but the new Status Board isn't being updated.

I'm in the Game `IMWARC with RFI`, as `Logistics`.   I can click on the first RFI and see this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/116510492-eab54b80-a8bc-11eb-8378-004fefe95527.png)

I then click on `Take Ownership`. But, the RFI does not change.

If I refresh the page and log in again, it shows the new status:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/116510603-133d4580-a8bd-11eb-9d70-6a3824be04a1.png)

Other logged in users also don't see the update.  Note: the status of the RFI _is_ updated in the `BLUE RFI` channel.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/116511506-724f8a00-a8be-11eb-9df7-4ecb9b971a6f.png)
